{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|gr1= Interpolation

|descr= Linear floating point interpolation (see {{Link|https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Linear_interpolation|Linear Interpolation}}).

|s1= [currentValue, targetValue, alpha] call [[BIS_fnc_lerp]]

|p1= currentValue: [[Number]] - first point (start)

|p2= targetValue: [[Number]] - second point (end)

|p3= alpha: [[Number]] - interpolation speed

|r1= [[Number]] - interpolated value

|x1= <sqf>[1, 10, 0.5] call BIS_fnc_lerp; // returns 5.5</sqf>

|seealso= [[:Category:Command Group: Math]]
}}
